system.name: nao
system.version: nao agent with dataset context layer, /api/agent SSE

declarations.artifacts: runs/nao_run1_fix.jsonl, runs/nao_run2.jsonl, runs/nao_run3.jsonl and runs/nao_run{1,2,3}_score_v1_1/ plus runs/nao_3run_score/ (organizer-side; per-task SQL, verdict, latency and cost for all three runs)
declarations.notes: Single-turn only: the 41 tier-9 multi-turn turns were not attempted and are scored as failures, which is why execution accuracy over the 190-task denominator sits below the single-turn subset figure. Runs 2 and 3 answered 148/149 and 147/149; run 1 declined 29 tasks, but only 3 tasks are solved by runs 2 and 3 and not by run 1, and none of those 3 were declines, so run 1 is not a degraded run. Token counts are unavailable: nao's SSE endpoint does not surface per-call usage, so tokens_per_task is null rather than estimated. Cost is the sum of nao's own reported per-task cost. Run 1's answers were re-executed against the release snapshot after an earlier run had hit a DuckDB catalog-name mismatch; the agent's generated SQL is unmodified and re-execution is the same path the harness uses for every arm. nao reads a dataset context layer carrying table and column documentation, which the LangChain and CrewAI arms do not, so this row is not a scaffold-only comparison with them.
